business_summary.text: Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing is a precision engineering company making aerospace tooling, precision components and assemblies for aerospace, defense, nuclear, semiconductor and energy customers.

call_points.text: Gross margin seen at 65% as a sustainable blended number for the year.
Gross block by FY27-end expected to roughly double, mainly from the Saudi JV investment.
About US$10 million to be infused into the Saudi JV this month.
165 FAIs completed in the quarter; engagement started with six additional prospective customers.
FACC Austria agreement initial value USD 7.5 million over five years; marks entry into recurring aerospace component supplies.
US tariff impact cannot be quantified; FTWZ and European/Saudi footprint are the mitigants.
Dheya, the Saudi JV with Kanoo, is looking to raise about USD 10 million; Unimech may see modest dilution but keeps exclusive manufacturing.
Declined to give a numeric FY27 revenue guidance despite analyst requests.
Order book at May 2026 was ₹314 Cr including Hobel, more than double historical levels.
Employee cost was 22% of FY26 revenue, up 16% YoY, and is targeted to moderate as revenue scales.
Working capital days at 120-125 at year-end, expected to rise to 150-160 days over time.
No significant core business capex planned for FY27; Kanoo JV capex will proceed as planned.
Saudi Kanoo JV plans $30 million joint investment, Unimech's share 51%, mostly in first three years.
Hobel Bellows acquisition completed in April 2026; consolidation starts Q1FY27.
FTWZ has all regulatory approvals; final SEZ clearance and ICEGATE portal enabling are in last stage.
About 5% tariff sharing on US-consumed parts and tooling continues and is considered manageable.
Kanoo JV may dilute consolidated margins as it starts up, though not in Q1 or Q2.

guidance.statement: Target Q1FY27 revenue to surpass Q4FY26 revenue
Consolidated EBITDA margins expected to be better than FY26
Working capital intensity may rise towards 150-160 days over time
FY27 EBITDA margin guided at 34-35% on a consolidated basis.
Gross margin seen at 65% as a sustainable blended number for the year.
Working capital days expected to rise to 160-plus by FY27-end.
Gross block by FY27-end expected to roughly double, mainly from Saudi JV investment.

entities.name: Dheya Engineering Technologies
entities.type: JV with Yusuf Bin Ahmed Kanoo Group, Saudi Arabia

former_names: Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing Private Limited

operating_notes.text: Aero tooling contributed about 90% of Q4FY26 and over 90% of FY26 revenue.
Current plant utilisation is about 50%, with improvement expected over 30-36 months.
Nuclear order wins of about ₹87 Cr are for EMCCR projects at Tarapur and Madras, to be executed in 12-18 months.
Hobel Bellows contributed ₹22 Cr over two months and 21% of Q1FY27 revenue.
Nuclear cumulative order wins about ₹87 Cr, with execution in H2FY27 and partly next year.
Capacity utilisation 58%, with nearly 10% of capacity committed to NPI and qualification programs.

holders.name: VALUEQUEST S C A L E FUND

predictions.kpi: FY27 EBITDA margin better than FY26's 31%

timeline.summary: On its Q4 FY26 call (May 29, 2026), Unimech reported FY26 revenue of ₹240 Cr net of tariff concessions (₹257 Cr gross) and PAT of ₹63 Cr, with an order book of ₹314 Cr including Hobel Bellows.

On 4 August 2026 Unimech held its Q1FY27 earnings call, reporting first consolidated revenue of about ₹108 Cr (up 71% YoY) with Hobel Bellows contributing ₹22 Cr over two months, an order book of about ₹280 Cr and FY27 EBITDA margin guidance of 34-35%.

watchlist.text: FY27 EBITDA margin better than FY26's 31%
Kanoo JV entity in process of approval to infuse funds

watchlist.response: No structural loss; tariff disruption was the cause and order inflows improved after February tariff cuts; tooling remains a PO-to-PO business.
watchlist.text: Order book excluding Hobel Bellows stayed roughly flat YoY; whether aero tooling has structural weakness as a client moves MRO tooling in-house.

watchlist.response: Declined numeric guidance; reiterated Q1FY27 revenue will surpass Q4FY26 and legacy business will also grow.
watchlist.text: FY27 revenue guidance requested; analyst noted Q1 growth may be mostly Hobel consolidation.

watchlist.response: Said margins will improve but giving an exact number would be optimistic; Kanoo JV may pull down consolidated margins for the year.
watchlist.text: Margin outlook: whether FY27 margins can return to 35-37%.

watchlist.response: Management declined to give a revenue growth number, saying it would go one quarter at a time, but guided to 34-35% EBITDA margin for FY27.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked for revenue growth and EBITDA margin guidance for FY27.

watchlist.response: Management declined to disclose margins by business, citing policy, and gave only consolidated EBITDA margin of 36.5%.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked for Hobel Bellows margins separately.

watchlist.response: Management said it is difficult to quantify and cited FTWZ, European customers and the Saudi footprint as mitigants.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked about the impact of potential 100% US tariffs on India.
